units.title: Actual fixed-spectrum precision determinant
units.reader_note: The determinant product is shown first; literal family, hypotheses, formula proof and exact Lean are folded below.
units.statement: The determinant of the actual rotated cosine-grid precision is the product of its displayed diagonal values.
assumptions: \(d\in\mathbb N,\ d\ge2,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge2\). Fix every actual \(O\in O(d)\), including either determinant sign. This assertion is pointwise; no Haar-law premise or determinant-one restriction is imposed.

For \(i=1,\ldots,d\), define \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\), and the actual precision \(A=O\Lambda O^\top\). Lean uses zero-based \(j.\mathrm{val}+1/2\), corresponding to source \(i=j.\mathrm{val}+1\).

The determinant is the genuine real finite determinant and the product ranges over every coordinate once. Orthogonality equations, determinant invariance and the diagonal-product identity are internal proved dependencies. No determinant, spectral-window, positivity or normalization identity is supplied as a new hypothesis.

The source bounds are retained exactly, although the determinant algebra itself needs no interval restriction on the diagonal values. The actual Gaussian consumer uses these bounds to obtain positive definiteness from the existing source admissibility result.

The real consumer is the same actual \(N(0,A^{-1})\) relative to Euclidean Lebesgue volume. Only its prefactor is independent of \(O\); the quadratic exponent retains the actual hidden orientation. The power \(d/2\) is real, including odd dimensions.

The explicit-product density is a mathematical identity. The separate unweighted Gaussian integral/known-normalizer proposition, full C.4 calculus/minimizer, moments/Krylov, operational oracle/precision/TV/cost adapters and both complete main lower bounds remain open.

steps.text: Apply the existing compiled determinant-only conjugation result to this actual carrier and the actual diagonal matrix. The same canonical declaration is reused, with no new generic invariant lemma.

steps.title: Identify the real transpose in the actual precision
steps.text: For real entries, the matrix star is the transpose. This identifies the actual conjugation result with the literal source precision, without restricting the orientation.
steps.lean: hstar is proved entrywise by Matrix.ext and real-star simplification. The actual hdet obtained from the canonical node is transported to M*diagonal(diagonalValue)*M.transpose.

steps.title: Expand the actual diagonal determinant
steps.text: The standard finite diagonal determinant formula gives one factor per displayed grid value. This is the explicit proof bridge behind the product formulation.
steps.lean: Matrix.det_diagonal closes the exact finite product. The source-to-Fin index mapping preserves all factors; it does not introduce an eigenvalue-window or product certificate as a binder.

steps.title: Consume the determinant in the actual Gaussian density
steps.text: The focused Test obtains positive definiteness from the existing actual admissibility theorem, applies the unchanged canonical Gaussian density leaf, and uses the new determinant result in its coefficient. The compiled consumer proof dependency inventory contains all three actual producers.
steps.lean: The Test-only private name permits inspection of the actual compiled proof without whole-proof pretty-printing. Its mathematical statement/binders are exactly the sealed consumer after erasing that private name. Dependencies are FixedSpectrumDeterminant.actual_precision_det, FixedSpectrumAdmissibility.actual_precision_admissible and the identical GaussianPrecisionDensity.multivariateGaussian_eq_withDensity_of_posDef.
